source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide whether personal hygiene, menstrual hygiene, and proper disposal of used sanitary pads are health practices that protect both the body and the community environment.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: An unwrapped used pad inside a dustbin is properly disposed of.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: A teenager without an infection must be practising good personal hygiene.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Only the armpits and pubic region need regular cleaning during adolescence.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Perfume on unwashed armpits provides the same protection from infection as washing.

intelligence.enrichment: Personal hygiene is crucial during adolescence, especially in the armpits and pubic region, because it may protect from potential infections. Proper menstrual hygiene supports comfort and health, and used sanitary pads should be wrapped and put inside a dustbin to support community health and environmental cleanliness. hygiene practices -> reduced infection risk and better comfort; proper pad disposal -> community health and environmental cleanliness The learner applies personal hygiene, menstrual hygiene, and proper wrapped dustbin disposal of used sanitary pads as practices that support body comfort, health, community health, and cleanliness. Hygiene during adolescence just means looking neat; disposal of used pads is someone else's problem.
